_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Maintainability and Built In Test Demonstration Report
summary: Records the results of contractor maintainability and Built In Test (BIT) demonstrations and tests, used by the procuring activity to evaluate the degree to which maintainability and BIT requirements have been met.
use_relationship:
The Maintainability and Built In Test (BIT) Demonstration Report is a formal record of the results of the contractor's maintainability and BIT demonstrations and tests and will be used by the procuring activity to evaluate the degree to which the maintainability and BIT requirements have been met. The report is used to deliver the results of maintainability and BIT demonstrations and tests, or tests from which maintainability/BIT evaluation is a byproduct.

Report(s) shall be submitted to the procuring activity in accordance with the schedule incorporated in the test plan and the contract data requirements. The procuring activity may require interim reports where additional detail or extended test durations may be involved.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, intended use information, and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task described in the solicitation, and should be tailored appropriately.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Maintainability and BIT Demonstration Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Maintainability and BIT Demonstration Report shall contain the results of each demonstration or test to demonstrate the maintainability/BIT achieved. The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Description of demonstration or test performed
Statement of test objectives
children.content: including type, unit of measure and quantitative goals or requirements to be demonstrated, including specific references to the applicable sections of the specification.

children.title: A list of all units that were placed on test during the demonstration
children.content: including any deviations from the configuration specified in the applicable test plan, and the detailed reason for each deviation.

children.title: Date and location of demonstration or test
Discussion of methods and conditions of the demonstration or test
children.content: including test plan and procedure used, source of inserted faults (i.e., revision and date of fault catalog), environmental and use conditions, operational and performance profiles, measurements, methods of evaluating the data obtained and comparison of the conditions with those anticipated in ultimate deployment and use of the contract item.

children.title: Results obtained
children.content: including specific identification and discussion of objectives demonstrated satisfactorily and those not demonstrated satisfactorily.

children.title: Factors which influenced the results
children.content: i.e., inserted fault sample size deviation from plan.

children.title: Assessment of the technical manuals, personnel, tools and test equipment, support equipment, maintenance concept and provisioning
children.content: for their effect on quantitative and qualitative demonstrated maintainability and BIT parameters.

children.title: Test incident reports, deficiencies, or failure reports generated and corrective action anticipated
Contractor's conclusion and recommendations based on evaluation of the results
Requirements for retest in cases where a reject decision was reached
